# holtburger-web 1070 perf campaign — 2026-10-06

Rig: GTX 1070 box, Chrome 154 (fresh profile, off-screen, muted, `--use-angle=d3d11`),
1280x633 canvas, `quality=mid` (the 1070's auto-detected preset), `adaptiveRes=off`,
`skytime=12`, Holtburg `@teleloc 0xA9B40001 96 96 80`, camera orbit 70 m / el 22 deg / 12 deg/s.
Drivers (scratchpad): `hbprobe.mjs` (fresh-boot attribution: census + CPU profile + GPU util),
`hbsess.mjs` (persistent session: boot/eval/snap/profile), `abwin.js` (interleaved in-session A/B).

## Baseline (HEAD 355f1eb9)
- ~23 fps, p50 41.7 ms, 1% low 13.3 fps. GPU util 22% => main-thread bound.
- ~2,000 draws/frame; three.js submission ~24 ms/frame (renderBufferDirect), setProgram 37% of all CPU.
- 950 material switches + 221 program switches per frame.
- Draw census: entity part meshes 814 (593 unique materials, ~40/humanoid NPC), cellstatic 480,
  surfaces-fused (interiors) 190, static particles ~250 (one Mesh + cloned material each),
  static-batch-c 167 (31 us/draw, 66 program switches over 13 programs).
- updateMatrixWorld 3.1 ms + projectObject 2.9 ms (7,776 nodes), tickPerFrame 4 ms.

## Found: black frame (the 10-05 NanScrub fix never worked)
- 2 NaN pixels from one interior cell material (surfaces-fused-opaque-a9b40147, group 1) => bloom
  smeared NaN over the whole frame => whole 3D view black on the 1070.
- Cause 1: Effect default blend NORMAL = mix(dst, src, 1) => NaN*0 = NaN, scrubbed pixel re-NaN'd.
- Cause 2: isnan() folded away by the D3D compile. Fix: SRC blend + exponent-bit test + clamp >= 0.
- Verified live: frame renders (mean 1.7 -> 107).

## Fix 1: program sort restored under ?punchRetail
- punchRetail's setOpaqueSort ran after installDrawSortProgram and replaced it. Phase is now the
  primary key inside the program sort.
- Program switches 246.6 -> 126.6 /frame. fps 23.7 -> 24.7, 1% low 13.8 -> 16.4.

## Fix 2: ?occlusionCull (GPU occlusion queries, interiors + entity rigs)
- Upper bound measured first: doorway-cells-only + indoor NPCs hidden = 24.5 -> 30.5 fps.
- Live A/B (4 reps x 6 s interleaved): 24.6 -> 28.1 fps, p50 41.6 -> 33.4 ms, 1% low 13.8 -> 19.0.
- Content draws ~1,630 -> ~1,140 (+~170 proxy draws). Snapshot diff on/off: only animation.

## Fix 3: ?particleInstancing default ON + alpha emitters (?particleInstancingAlpha)
- Static AND world/entity managers; alpha buckets: opacity in instanceColor.r applied as alpha
  (one program key), back-to-front instance sort per tick. OpenAC does the same (one instanced draw
  per blend key, distance sorted).
- In-page A/B: 28.1 -> 29.7 fps, 1,294 -> 1,154 draws. Smoke/fountain puffs eye-checked.

## Hitch attribution (teleport tours, CPU profile correlated to frame timestamps)
- 3-LB tour: 8.1 s of >50 ms frames; 3.8 s = getProgramParameter (forced first-use shader LINK);
  worst frames 2,258 / 1,700 ms were pure links. Rest: static atlas NRA packing 0.35-0.4 s in one
  frame, basis/XU7 transcode, texSubImage2D, wasm bake.
- Shoushi: 2 programs linked at first draw: 1,658 ms + 1,082 ms (MeshStandard variants: one feature
  bit; a windSwayGpu tree material). Missed by the existing prewarm paths.

## Fix 4: ?asyncLink (scene3d/async_link_guard.js)
- Draws of the main scene whose material has no program / a still-linking program / a version we
  have not compiled are SKIPPED and compiled off-frame (one compile() per drain via a duck-typed root,
  a cached-lights stand-in target scene; per-material KHR_parallel_shader_compile readiness polls).
- Single cold Shoushi tours: max hitch 1,700 -> 708-850 ms; 1% low 3.5 -> 5.0 fps; 0.1% low 0.7 -> 2.1 fps.
  3x3 rep bench pending.

## Fix 5: static atlas NRA packing via 256-entry LUTs (byte-identical; 2.4x faster loop).
## Fix 6: ?skipHiddenMatrix — scene walk skips invisible subtrees, re-shown subtrees force-recompute.

## asyncLink bench (hbbench.mjs on frozen snapshot s1, 3 reps/arm, cold Shoushi teleport tour)
| arm | still fps | tour jank | worst hitch | tour 1% low | tour 0.1% low |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| asyncLink=off | 29.7 | 10.06 s | 1650 / 2067 / 2133 ms | 3.0 | 0.6 |
| asyncLink on  | 28.2 | 6.48 s  | 358 / 525 / 533 ms   | 6.1 | 2.9 |
- Steady -1.5 fps came from per-draw checks -> fixed with a per-material `__hbLinkOk` stamp (owner-checked
  for prototype variants). In-page A/B after the fix: 31.2 vs 31.2 fps (no cost).

## Live findings (session on live tree == s2)
- _rescanSetupLights ran 201x per 10 s settled (world_stream calls loadEnvCellsForLandblock on every
  position update; the idempotent path still rescanned statics+buildings+cells+entities). Fixed: skip on
  idempotent/inFlight results.
- skipHiddenMatrix in-page A/B: 28.8 -> 30.4 fps.
- Fog probe getBufferSubData stalled 189 ms behind a driver shader compile -> skip probe while asyncLinkBusy().

## Round 3 (s2/s3 benches)
- texWorkers (existing DEV flag) default ON: tour jank 5.5/5.8 -> 4.2/5.1 s, tour 0.1% low 3.6/3.2 -> 5.2/4.3.
  Default only where Web Workers exist (node harness: off).
- batchMatVariant=off was +1.5 fps steady but 1.3-1.5 s flip links. Profile diff + node micro-bench: Object.create
  variants make three's material reads megamorphic for EVERY draw (2.2x slower reads). Variants are now
  shape-identical clones synced per frame (hot keys + 1/32 round-robin full sweep: 0.67 -> ~0.1 ms).
- Guard: object-kind + geometry-signature variants; never-drawn prewarmed materials; rate-capped version defers.
  Cold street-level sweep: 0 synchronous links (was 1.0-1.33 s).
- Fog probe: memoised three readability queries (a 194 ms getParameter stall behind a driver compile).
- skipHiddenMatrix uses three's matrixWorldNeedsUpdate (no new node property).

## Open leads
- First camera sweep after boot: one ~1 s frame with ~no main-thread JS (GPU process / first-use uploads); needs a
  Chrome trace (GPU process) to attribute.
- Static BatchedMesh draws ~26-30 us each (3 batching textures + uniforms per draw); entity parts ~330 draws.
- Retail per-part degrade (GfxObjDegradeInfo id 0 terminal band => humanoid parts not drawn beyond ~134 m;
  s_rDegradeDistance 50) — neither this client nor OpenAC implements it; JS-only via fetch_gfx_obj_degrade_info.
- Cell statics are multi-material arrays: a per-(cell, material) triangle merge would take ~351 -> ~200 draws.
